tutorial_home_hint: This button takes you to the tutorial screen on how to use the app.
download_home_hint:
This button takes you to the climate data download screen.
You can download data from NOAA and ECMWF organizations.
imputation_home_hint:
This button takes you to the imputation home page. 
On this page, you process the data you want to impute, 
visualize that data, and perform the imputation.
trends_home_hint:
This button takes you to the page where you can calculate
 climate extremes and plot climate trends.
download_method_hint:
Choose between the options NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration)
 and ECMWF (European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts).
city_download_entry_hint:
Enter the city you want to download data for.
 To work, it must be in the format 'City, Country'.
start_date_download_hint:
Enter the start date for the data download.
 The date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
end_date_download_hint:
Enter the end date for the data download.
 The date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
radius_download_hint:
For NOAA data, you need to define the search radius 
relative to the city's coordinates on the globe.
alvo_data_hint:
Select the city you want to assign as the target.
 It will be the focus of imputation. First, you must select the data folder.
viz1_data_hint:
Select the city that will be neighbor 1 of the target city,
 necessary for data imputation. First, you must select the data folder.
viz2_data_hint:
Select the city that will be neighbor 2 of the target city,
 necessary for data imputation. First, you must select the data folder.
viz3_data_hint:
Select the city that will be neighbor 3 of the target city,
 necessary for data imputation. First, you must select the data folder.
select_dir_data_hint: Button to select the folder containing the data you want to use.
confirm_group_data_hint:
Button to confirm the target city and its neighbors.
 Process necessary to use the features of this page.
visualize_data_hint: Button that takes you to the data visualization page for the cities selected by the Confirm Group button.
imputation_data_hint: Button that takes you to the screen with imputation technique choices.
show_location_data_hint: Button that opens a window with the location of the selected cities on the map.
combo_data_view_hint: Select which city's data you want to visualize.
parameter_view_hint:
Select the parameter to be the focus of visualization.
Maximum Temperature, Minimum Temperature, or Precipitation.
start_view_hint: Select the start year of the data you want to visualize.
end_view_hint: Select the end year of the data you want to visualize.
graph_data_10_view_hint: Select which city you want to view the graph for the last 10 years.
graph_param_10_view_hint: Select the climate parameter you want to view on the graph.
histogram_view_hint:
Button to generate a histogram chart of the last 10 years.
Necessary to select the Data and Parameter first.
boxplot_view_hint:
Button to generate a Boxplot chart of the last 10 years.
Necessary to select the Data and Parameter first.
triangulation_input_hint: Button that directs to the data triangulation technique screen.
machine_learning_input_hint: Button that directs to the machine learning method screen.
meta_learning_input_hint: Button that directs to the meta learning method screen.
method_triang_hint: Select one of the triangulation methods.
param_triang_hint: Select the parameter you want to triangulate.
btn_triang_hint: Button that starts the triangulation and generates the resulting graph.
data_MaL_hint: Select the city data you want to use for machine learning.
para_MaL_hint: Select the climate parameter that will be used in machine learning.
train_percent_MaL_hint: Percentage (of 100%) of data separated for training, the rest is used for model testing.
number_tests_MaL_hint: Number of tests the model will perform.
model_MaL_hint: Select the machine learning model you want to use.
optuna_MaL_hint:
Button used to optimize the Machine Learning model Hyperparameters,
 which tends to improve results, but may take time.
generate_prev_MaL_hint: Button that generates a preview graph of the selected model's results.
